exposure: Spondyloarthritis (SpA) and subtypes (ankylosing spondylitis, psoriatic arthritis, reactive arthritis, arthritis associated with inflammatory bowel diseases, and undifferentiated SpA)
cohort: 1,199,610 singleton pregnancies in Denmark between 1997 and 2016
finding: Pregnancies in women with SpA were more often complicated by adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth, cesarean section, and epidural use, compared to pregnancies in women without SpA.
mod_finding: Women with SpA had higher odds of both elective (ORadj 1.44 [95% CI 1.26-1.64]) and emergency cesarean section (ORadj 1.17 [95% CI 1.04-1.33]) compared to women without SpA.
